customer_text: My driver cancelled my ride and I am still waiting
reply_text: Sorry about that. Please request a new ride in the app, and we'll review the cancellation if a charge appears.

customer_text: I was charged twice for my trip
reply_text: We can help with a duplicate charge. Please select the trip in the app and choose Get trip help.

customer_text: My promo code does not work
reply_text: Sorry your promotion did not apply. Check its expiry and eligibility in the app, then contact support from the trip if it still fails.

customer_text: I cannot sign in to my account
reply_text: Try resetting your password from the sign-in screen. If that does not work, contact us through the Help section.

customer_text: The driver has not arrived for pickup
reply_text: Please check the driver's location in the app. You can contact the driver or cancel and request another ride if needed.
